description: The job search that runs on your machine. AI job application framework built on Claude Code: evaluate postings, tailor CVs, write cover letters, prep interviews. Fork it and own it.
summary: I like that the whole thing runs on your machine and the deliverable is a fork you own, which is the local-first, composable shape I'm trying to push in Proreerfolio rather than another SaaS that holds your career data hostage. The drafter-reviewer pipeline for CVs and cover letters is a clean two-agent pattern that kills the Sunday-night rewriting toil without any cloud dependency, and the portal-search skills are swappable per market, so the core workflow stays language-agnostic. The author's own funnel numbers—69 applications, 20 first interviews, 1 signed contract—are the kind of grounded, no-bullshit proof I want to see instead of another "AI will revolutionize job search" headline.
